run_monocular_depth_estimation: run the demo script to predict monocular depth maps from a list of input images using pretrained checkpoints
run_resnet_encoder_inference: run the ResnetEncoder to extract multi-scale feature representations from input images for depth estimation
run_depth_decoder_prediction: run the DepthDecoder on encoder features to produce multi-scale disparity predictions
convert_disparity_to_metric_depth: convert raw disparity output to metric depth values in meters using the output_to_depth utility function
visualize_depth_map: visualize a predicted depth map using matplotlib turbo colormap and save as a PNG image
